=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11309-11326 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the `set_tracking_phase_label` failure branch of `maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion`, `mv "${fmar_state_backup}" "${STATE_FILE}"` restores a backup taken before the head was added to `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas`, so the head drops out of the ledger and the same head qualifies again on every tick.
  WHY: While the label write keeps failing (missing `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json` at line 4514, `resolve-phase` failure at line 4522, repeated `gh issue edit` failure at line 4571, or a gh API outage), each tick repeats the PR, checks and compare reads and writes two full V2 state chains; the progress entry added via `record_poll_progress_if_advanced` (line 3802) and `${RUNTIME_DIR}/poll_progress_tracking_issues` (line 3711) is never removed, so a follow-up poll is queued every 300 s (`FORCE_TICK_COOLDOWN_SECONDS: '300'` in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` around lines 1904-1942) and the state never converges; all three reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low here).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11293 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry ledger `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` is capped with `.[-200:]`, so once 200 distinct head SHAs are recorded the oldest entries are evicted.
  WHY: If the final PR is later reset to an evicted SHA and passes all gates, the `index($h) != null` / `already_resumed_on_head` check at line 11218 misses it and the same SHA is retried a second time, which breaks the at-most-one-retry-per-head-SHA contract in issue #9320 item 4; glm notes this is practically unreachable, and all reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low here).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11309-11324 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After `post_state_comment` succeeds and `set_tracking_phase_label` fails, the re-persist of the restored parked state is best-effort, yet the function always logs `reason=lookup_failed detail=label_write` and returns 1 whether or not the re-persist worked.
  WHY: If the re-persist also fails, the durable comment still says `status=validating` with the head in the ledger while the local file and the `ai:blocked` label show the parked state; the next tick reads `validating` (or logs `already_resumed_on_head`), so the auto-resume is silently lost or stranded and the logs give no sign of the divergence; both reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low here).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Extend the existing poller tests (`tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` and the final-merge tests) to cover: a green, mergeable final PR is resumed and merges; red required checks, a non-mergeable PR, a closed PR, and a failed lookup are each skipped with the right reason; a second tick on the same head SHA doesn't retry again; ..." plus the fail-closed requirement "If any lookup fails or returns something unexpected, skip the retry for that tick and log why" (issue #9320 / #8984, Tests section). These now apply to the persist-before-label ordering and the restore-on-failure paths added by the last run.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, specifically the FMAR harness (`_run_final_merge_exhausted_tick` / `_assert_final_merge_auto_resume_skipped`), covering `reason=lookup_failed detail=state_persist` and `reason=lookup_failed detail=label_write`
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `test_final_merge_auto_resume_skip_reasons` and `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:31837-32077` cover only the gate skips (checks_not_green, not_mergeable, pr_not_open, pr_read, compare, not_ahead, no_validated_sha, comprehensive_cycle_aborted), the disabled switch, already_resumed_on_head and other-failed projects, `test_final_merge_auto_resume_retries_green_mergeable_pr` covers only the happy path, and no test makes `post_state_comment` or `set_tracking_phase_label` fail, so the fail-closed paths at lines 11305-11325 have no coverage.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11309-11326 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Moving `post_state_comment` ahead of `set_tracking_phase_label` means the resumed state is saved before the label write. That save calls `record_poll_progress_if_advanced` (line 3802), the `poll_progress_fingerprint` (lines 3683-3686) changes, and the tracking issue is added to `${RUNTIME_DIR}/poll_progress_tracking_issues` (line 3711). If the label write then fails, the backup is restored without the head in the ledger, the state is re-saved, and the progress entry is never removed.
  WHY: Label failures that repeat every tick (line 4514 missing label contract, line 4522 `resolve-phase` failure, line 4571 `gh issue edit` failure) mean each tick passes all gates again, does the PR, checks and compare reads, writes two full V2 state chains, and queues a follow-up poll every 300 s (`.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` around lines 1904-1942). Hardening suggestion (risk score 1, about 3 lines): after the re-save, remove `${TRACKING_NUM}` from the progress file, or save the baseline fingerprint again, or keep the head in the restored backup's ledger.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11314-11326 (approximately) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The label-failure branch restores `${STATE_FILE}.fmar.bak`, which predates the head being added to `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas`, so every later tick qualifies the same head again and repeats the backup, write, persist, restore and re-persist cycle.
  WHY: While `set_tracking_phase_label` keeps failing, the cycle repeats on every 300 s force-tick cooldown, and the at-most-one-retry-per-head-SHA guarantee is silently lost for that head.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11293 (around) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `.[-200:]` cap evicts the oldest head SHAs once 200 have been retried.
  WHY: If the head is reset to an evicted SHA, the `index($h) != null` check fails and the same SHA is retried again, which violates issue #9320 item 4.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11320-11324 (around) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The re-persist after a label failure is best-effort, but the function always logs `reason=lookup_failed detail=label_write` and returns 1.
  WHY: If the re-persist also fails, the durable state keeps `status=validating` with the head in the ledger, the next tick logs `already_resumed_on_head` or stays in `validating`, and the auto-resume is silently lost with no log signal.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Tests section of issue #9320 / #8984 ("Extend the existing poller tests ... `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED=false` restores today's behaviour."), applied to the new fail-closed ordering.
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, with coverage showing that a `post_state_comment` failure and a `set_tracking_phase_label` failure each leave the project parked and unchanged, with the matching skip reason.
  Evidence of absence: `test_final_merge_auto_resume_skip_reasons` and `test_final_merge_auto_resume_retries_green_mergeable_pr` do not mock either function to fail.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11293 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The retry ledger keeps only the latest 200 head SHAs (`.[-200:]`), so the once-per-head guarantee does not hold for older entries.
  WHY: An evicted head pushed back to the final PR is not found by the membership check at line 11218, so that SHA is retried a second time.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11319-11325 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On a label-write failure, `mv "${fmar_state_backup}" "${STATE_FILE}"` removes the head from `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` (the backup predates the ledger append at line 11293), so every tick passes the gates again and repeats the write, persist, label failure, restore and re-persist cycle.
  WHY: With a label write that keeps failing, the poller writes two state comments per project per tick and queues follow-up polls with no convergence.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11309-11324 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If the re-persist at line 11322 fails after a label failure, the durable state stays `status=validating` with the head in the ledger while `ai:blocked` remains, and the log line is identical to the clean-restore case.
  WHY: The project is silently stranded in `validating`: dispatch timestamps were zeroed at lines 11295-11297, `ai:blocked` was never removed, and no tracking comment was posted.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11293 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `.[-200:]` ledger cap evicts the oldest entries.
  WHY: An evicted SHA misses the `already_resumed_on_head` check at line 11218 and is retried a second time; this is practically unreachable.

  Evidence of absence: `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:31837-32077` has no test that makes `post_state_comment` or `set_tracking_phase_label` fail, so lines 11305-11325 have no coverage.
